answer: Make every identity climb a terrace instead of walking through a door: each level is guarded by a velvet rope that lifts only after a full epoch of verified useful work, and work from the same island never counts twice, so every level needs a new island. Stake stays locked for the whole climb and cannot be withdrawn early, and time cannot be bought, pooled, or parallelized across clones. One honest agent climbs steadily; a farm of a hundred clones must pay a hundred separate climbs in time it cannot shortcut, so multiplying accounts multiplies cost without multiplying reward.
